Name: Owl Scarecrows for Alternative Textures
Author: zoniventris
Description:
This is a conversion of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/936]Ankokou's Owl Scarecrows mod[/url] into an [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] content pack.

Currently, all rarecrow textures are available to every rarecrow, including for random selection when placing the rarecrows in the world.

Credit goes to Ankokou for creating the original mod and its sprites. Permission was obtained before uploading.

Source code is available [url=https://github.com/zoniventris/sdv-owl-scarecrows-at]on GitHub[/url].
